title: R2SC-B2 · POST /modules/{leads}/records/{id}/attachments accepts files that do not exist (CRM Admin B, 28 Oct 2026)
lines: 1. POST /files {purpose: attachment, qa-r2sc-ghost.pdf, 2048 B}  -> 201  (file created, status 'pending', nothing uploaded)
POST …/attachments {file_id: <pending file>, size: 2048}  -> 201  attachment row created
POST /files/<id>/download  -> 409 "File is 'pending' and not available for download."
3. POST …/attachments {file_id: <real 64 B pdf>, size: 999999999}  -> 201, stored size 999999999 (screen shows 954 MB)
Re-run from scratch in the Java suite (AT-04, AT-05): same results.
Expected: 4xx unless the file exists, is confirmed, belongs to the tenant; size and type taken from the stored file.
